phases.name: Get ready (you)
phases.goal: Back up, repo, answers — before anyone builds

phases.name: Clean-up
phases.goal: One source of truth; old files archived

phases.name: Templates
phases.goal: 8 approved visual blocks driven by one registry

phases.name: Core pipeline
phases.goal: Clips in → draft + edit package out

phases.name: QA + Committee
phases.goal: Checks and scoring before you see a reel

phases.name: Costs
phases.goal: Caps enforced, ledger correct

phases.name: Real reels
phases.goal: 3 real clips end to end, measured

phases.name: Later
phases.goal: B-roll, more effects, calibration

phases.name: Independent + smarter
phases.goal: Runs on its own Nous key without Hermes, spend governed in the Nous portal, cheaper where quality allows, learns from Hesham's comments

phases.name: NOW · Close the pending tasks (Nov 2–4)
phases.goal: Claude finishes every task that doesn't need you. Main priority.

phases.name: YOUR TURN · Answers and the full test (Nov 4–7)
phases.goal: Your short answers + one full reel test from upload to final video

phases.name: NEXT · Timeline editor (from Nov 9)
phases.goal: Upload footage to a real timeline, AI Check my cuts, AI Auto-edit

phases.name: LATER · Ideas, no date yet
phases.goal: Only after the pending tasks and the timeline are done

phases.name: NEXT · Stage 6 rendering and checking (starts when you say go)
phases.goal: Safer rendering, stronger automatic checks, clear errors, quick re-renders

phases.name: NOW · Pipeline redesign + creative brief (Nov 2-4)
phases.goal: One shared understanding of the footage, a creative brief before editing, and hook choice

phases.name: TEST ROUND · Check what was built (you, on your Mac)
phases.goal: Merge, update, then one real reel with the new features; tell Claude what breaks

phases.name: PARKED · Closed without being built (reopen when you want)
phases.goal: Needs your Mac, your screens, your style OK or extra cost

phases.name: NOW · Fixes from your first real reel (Nov 2)
phases.goal: AI that really edits, correct captions, real sound and richer visuals, a better cover

phases.name: NEXT · Reach the reference quality (Format Packs)
phases.goal: A designed look like the two Higgsfield reels: persistent frame, steps, recap diagram, icons, theme colours

phases.name: NEXT · Foundation upgrade (structure, models, cost)
phases.goal: One clear structure, a strong model per job, a cost you can see and set
